narr: A stationary thunderstorm stayed over the area for several hours and produced significant amount of rain over the area.
ev: Heavy rain induced landslide reported near Dead Horse Point on nf-5400. There were no observations directly in the in area. The observations in the general area showed amounts of half an inch.
lsr: HEAVY RAIN INDUCED LANDSLIDE REPORTED NEAR DEADHORSE POINT ON NF-5400.
